changes: Use VK video access keys in API identifiers as owner_id_video_id_access_key, matching VK API conventions.
Add a single shared fixed-position quality menu to prevent stacked/overlapping menus.
Remove direct-link arrow buttons from quality rows; clicking the quality row downloads that exact resolution.
Persist the last known successful quality set per exact video ID and reuse it immediately on subsequent hovers.
Deduplicate concurrent resolver requests per exact video ID.
Treat type=0..5 signed VK CDN streams as valid and infer 144/240/360/480/720/1080p from type when needed.
Prevent the second click from reaching VK native controls and starting an unintended large native download.
Keep clips, stories, circles/video messages and attachment-download logic outside the normal-video quality picker path.
